title: C++17 for Competitive Programming
subtitle: A structured course built on the classified Olimpiici Arena catalogue (Groups C and D, 2007-2026)

catalog.label: Problem catalogue
catalog.note: 768 problems, each tagged with a primary algorithm, an optional secondary algorithm, technique tags, a 1-5 difficulty and a one-line hint.

tracks.title: Part I - Language and data structures
tracks.blurb: The C++17 you actually type in a contest, at the level of a 5th or 6th grader: only the basics. Lessons 01 to 16 are self-contained, follow the shape of Lesson 03, and end with 12 Group D problems from the catalogue, grouped by subtopic and getting harder as you go. Lesson 17 closes the part with 33 more problems in rounds of three, like a real contest.

lessons.title: Setup, I/O and the contest toolkit
lessons.summary: The skeleton of every solution: reading numbers and characters, printing exactly what is asked, and checking before you send.
covers: the program skeleton, compiling and running
cin >> and cout <<, spaces and new lines
a count, then that many numbers - answering while reading
the best so far and the longest streak
reading characters one at a time, and until the input ends

fast input, and '
' instead of endl

lessons.title: Numbers: int, long long, bool and double
lessons.summary: Which number type to use, how / and % take a number apart, and when a formula beats a loop.
covers: int and long long - and overflow
n(n+1)/2 and counting multiples with a formula
double, setprecision, and exact square roots

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.summary: Words and text: characters as numbers, walking along a string, counting letters and palindromes.
covers: runs of equal characters, and find

lessons.title: Arrays - a row of numbered boxes

covers: reading and printing, forwards and backwards

lessons.title: std::vector - a list that grows

lessons.title: Counting and frequency arrays

lessons.title: Two-dimensional arrays and grids

lessons.title: Pairs and structs

{value, number} to remember who is who

returning a pair from a function

filters.note: Pairs and Structs are thin in Group D; the lesson selects on shape: positions, (value, number) pairs and records sorted by several rules

lessons.title: Priority queues

lessons.title: Practice contests - eleven rounds of three

tracks.title: Part II - Algorithms and techniques
tracks.blurb: One technique per lesson, in the order the catalogue rewards. Each assumes Part I and nothing else.
